newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST -- Czech Republic -- Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST -- Czech Republic -- Jan 7.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Agrobanka will probably post losses of a few billion crowns in 1996 due to reserve problems and items of correction for risk and idle business.
- Insurance funds began last year with a substantial increase in gross profits. For the first three quarters of 1996, insurance expenses and returns increased in mid-year by 80 percent.
- The Industry and Trade Ministry has announced that only state-owned Transgas will receive a licence to import natural gas into the Czech Republic.
- Financial institutions ended the third quarter of last year with losses approximately one billion crowns.

- The oil pipeline Ingolstadt transported almost one-fifth of all oil brought into the Czech Republic last year. The building of the pipline cost nearly 14 billion crowns and ended Czech dependence on Russian supplies.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - President Vaclav Havel will instate Vlasta Parkanova as the country's new Justice Minister today. After a long interview with Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus, she was recommended for the position.
- Cigarette prices have gone up this year because nearly all participants on the domestic market decided to increase prices by about 10 percent.
PRAVO - Vice-chairman of the cabinet and Agriculture Minister Josef Lux was attacked yesterday afternoon in his office by an intruder with a knife and nerve gas. No one was injured.
- Exports of Czech beer to Slovakia are growing this year. Approximately 700 to 800 hectolitres of beer should be exported to Slovakia this year.
